_comment: Ratchet for bun run test:audit. Counts normally only go down: lower a number in the same commit that lowers the count. A number may go UP only when the DETECTOR got stricter and started seeing sites that were always there, never to admit new ones — raise it in the same commit as the detector change and record the reason below.
_wallClock: 0. The last ten sites went in one pass (see the PR that lowered this line). Each became either a BRACKET — two clock readings taken either side of the call, so the stamp is pinned to an instant inside them and no tolerance encodes machine speed — an EVENT ORDER (the estimator is released only after the route has answered; a shutdown marker due before the drain's own timer, which the event loop therefore always fires first), a WAIT rather than an assertion (the review-item precondition loops until the clock leaves the stamped millisecond, which slowness only makes arrive sooner), or a COUNT in the style of list-docs-linear.test.ts (paragraph re-scans, round trips, eager binds). Nothing was deleted to reach zero: every rewrite was shown red against a deliberately broken timing. A number here may go UP only if the detector gets stricter.
_sourceShape: 42. Was 36, and 36 was never a census. The detector matched a read and its path literal on the SAME LINE, so a formatter decided what it could see: PR 718 renamed src/hub/ to src/board/, the longer name pushed `readFileSync(join(__dirname, '..', 'src', 'hub', 'hub-live-wiring.ts'), 'utf8')` in walk-handoff.test.ts past biome's width, biome wrapped it, and the count fell 52 -> 51 with nothing converted. The window is now the read call's own parentheses, followed across wrapped lines, which surfaced SIX reads that were always there: walk-handoff.test.ts:65, board-quick-actions.test.ts:281 and :285, board-nav-widget-clearance-css.test.ts:28, css-minify.test.ts:21 and review-item-comments.test.tsx:633. Nothing was added to the suite and nothing regressed — the before/after --list diff is six additions and zero removals. THE NUMBER WENT UP BECAUSE THE DETECTOR GOT STRICTER, which is the one direction this file allows it to move. What is still invisible, so nobody reads 42 as a census either: a read whose path is in a constant declared elsewhere (review-item-tools.test.ts reads a BUNDLE const), a support module outside a test/ directory, and require(). What went for real on the way down from 52: the six MCP tests that grepped the committed bundle now run it over stdio (packages/mcp/test/harness/mcp-bundle.ts), pushing frames down its event stream and reading the channel line, or calling the tool and reading the POST body — every one of them was verified to go red against a deliberately broken bundle, and three of the six old assertions stayed GREEN under the same mutation. The nine artifact reads in client-release.test.ts and launcher.test.ts carry the per-site `// audit: not-source — <reason>` marker: neither reads repo source at all (a tmpdir the test just published into, and a manifest that is JSON.parse'd for two fields), and the reason line at each site says what break it catches. What remains to convert: nine MCP tests reading packages/mcp/src through test/harness/mcp-source.ts; the app tests that read board/*.ts, app.ts, board-live-wiring.ts, doc-meeting-mount.ts and meeting-strip.ts as TEXT and assert on that text — board-app.ts and app.ts have exported bootBoard and bootApp since PR 634, so the honest reason these stay is that nobody has converted them yet; and the stylesheet reads, of which decide-option-hover-css.test.ts (a :hover treatment), board-nav-widget-clearance-css.test.ts (a calc() of max() and env() that happy-dom discards whole) and shell-grid-placement.test.ts (grid auto-placement, which needs a layout engine) are all beyond happy-dom.
